shortDescription: Europe needs a change in mindset on innovation and technology and must take bolder action or risk falling further behind the US and China, according to Bloomberg. Ireland’s prime minister, Martin, made the warning in remarks on the region’s competitiveness.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Ireland’s Martin Warns EU Could Lag US and China Further
